{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Crazy pilot''! They could've ''killed'' somebody!''"<br />"''It's a ''miracle'' they didn't&mdash;and ''besides'', doesn't look like they had much of a choice! That was ''some landing''.|Ovin and Jenna|<ref name="TCK" />}}
'''Ovin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who resided in a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corellian settlement|settlement]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Jenna)|planet]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. After witnessing the crash of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the settlement, he commented that its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was crazy and could have killed somebody. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] left the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and fell unconscious, [[Jenna (Corellian)|Jenna]] asked Ovin to fetch a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]].
